presets.description: Light presets (config/atmosphere.default.json) whose maps get dust unless map.json says otherwise

styles.description: Facade styles (config/facade_styles.json) whose maps get dust unless map.json says otherwise

volumes.description: Emission volumes on the map, over its AI routes

apart_m.description: Least distance between two volumes' centres

spawn_clear_m.description: Least distance from a volume's centre to a spawn point or an objective

box_m.description: A volume's width, depth and height

base_m.description: Height of a volume's floor over the ground

drift_m_s.description: Wind speed the motes drift at, in one heading per map

color.description: Colour of the motes when the map's light preset has no fog colour

max_particles.description: Motes in one volume at most
